newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IMPLATS REFINERY WORKERS STILL ON STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: IMPLATS REFINERY WORKERS STILL ON STRIKE.

text.p: Impala Platinum Holdings Ltd (Implats) said on Monday more than 400 workers at its platinum refineries were still on strike.
Implats spokeswoman Marilyn Watson said the workers, members of the National Union of Mineworkers (NUM), were still on strike after embarking on industrial action over wages on August 4.
"The workers are still on strike. The negotiating teams met on Friday but they couldn't come to an agreement," she said.
She said production had not been affected because non-striking members of the 1,100-strong workforce had kept the refineries going.
Management's last wage offer was a 10.7 percent increase, against the NUM's last demand of 19.2 percent.
Implats produced 499,000 ounces of refined platinum in the six months to end-December 1996 and normal output is around a million ounces a year.
